source: Ours, the training twin of eval_awareness_pairs.json: the real statements are Hua et al.'s (arXiv:2510.20487, Table 12), verbatim; each evaluation statement is reworded with training instead of evaluation or testing wording, keeping its structure and about its length. Written to mirror Table 12 the way Aranguri reworded his 'testing' contrast prompts as 'training' (Aranguri, 'Different eval awareness may track different graders', LessWrong, 25-10-2026); his exact rewrites aren't public. Read like the eval pairs: mean(train) - mean(real) at the colon ending each prompt, formatted as a user message with each model's own chat template, no system prompt.
heldout_rule: the last four pairs (13-16), fixed before any run
